content:
Sequences Series — Quick Reference

Key Formulas / Values

n-th term of an A.P. series: a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d

sum of n terms of an A.P. series: S_n = n/2 * [2a_1 + (n - 1)d]

n-th term of a G.P. series: a_n = a_1 * r^(n - 1)

sum of n terms of a G.P. series: S_n = a_1 * (1 - r^n) / (1 - r)

Mnemonics

Arithmetic Progression (A.P.) : same difference, Geometric Progression (G.P.) : same ratio

Key Points

  • Arithmetic Mean (A.M.) is always greater than or equal to Geometric Mean (G.M.)
  • Harmonic Mean (H.M.) is always less than or equal to Geometric Mean (G.M.)
  • For an A.P. series, the sum of the series is the average of the first and last term, multiplied by the number of terms
  • For a G.P. series, the sum of the series is the first term divided by (1 - common ratio), if |r| < 1
